verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some one-action-affects-many behavior. Credential rotation propagates to every Sprite at once, access can be granted by label across groups of Sprites, `fly scale` scales many Machines horizontally, and a single command can deploy across regions. However, nothing documents a general bulk-operation capability, such as batch endpoints or multi-target selectors for acting on arbitrary sets of Machines, apps, or volumes. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or CLI operations across arbitrary resource sets, label-based bulk actions beyond access grants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
